Identity Platform is the trust root of Phantom: we own authentication, unlocking, onboarding/key generation, and the signing pipeline that every transaction flows through.   • Ship passkeys (WebAuthn) and MFA improvements with a strong security/usability balance.

  • Own onboarding and key lifecycle flows: key generation/derivation, seed phrase flows, seedless registration, hardware wallet pairing.

  • Own sensitive key export/import experiences and related safety rails.

  • Write and maintain high-signal, non-flaky tests (unit/integration/e2e) for critical paths; ensure safe rollouts via monitoring and staged releases.

job_description:
Kit is an email-first operating system for creators who mean business. We help creators grow and monetize their audience with ease. For coaches, YouTubers, authors, podcasters, and other creatives, there isn't a better marketing hub to rely on to grow audiences, automate email marketing, and sell digital products — all within one platform.

More importantly, there isn't a team more committed to helping creators earn a living. We're on a mission to help creators earn $1 billion using our creator marketing platform. We have always been 100% independent and 100% remote.

We are proud to have built a product that our customers love, and we look for people who have enthusiasm and belief in our mission, vision, and values to join our team. We're also embracing AI thoughtfully — both in how we build and how we hire to ensure our team is adaptable, innovative, and ready for what's next.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the products that help creators grow their audience and monetize their work at scale.

You'll be joining the Network Squad, which owns Creator Growth through recommendation products and Creator Monetization via our Newsletter Sponsorships and Commerce platforms. We build products where network effects drive value—as more creators participate, everyone benefits. Your work directly impacts how thousands of creators find their audience and earn a living, with measurable outcomes like 2x faster audience growth for creators using our recommendation network.

This is a hands-on role for a product-minded engineer with strong product engineering skills and front-end experience. You'll work across the full stack—from React frontends to our Rails backend and analytics systems—and you care deeply about creating great user experiences. You partner well with Design and Product throughout the design process, contributing to early concepts, refining rough ideas, and breaking down ambitious features into iterative deliverables that ship value to creators sooner. You contribute to scoping conversations, help identify MVPs, and support iterative release planning so creators benefit throughout the development process, not just at the end. You're data-driven and contribute to product improvements while bringing modern approaches to performance and user experience.

You're proficient with AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code and Cursor, and leverage them to broaden your impact.

 

Your support system

You'll report to Mark Southard who leads the Network Squad, a cross-functional product team at Kit. You'll collaborate closely with a Product Manager, Product Designer, and peer Software Engineers.

What you'll do

  • First Week: Dive into our codebase and learn how our growth and monetization products work. Set up your local environment and merge your first production code. Take part in Get To Know You's (GTKYs) to meet our distributed team.

  • First Month: Drive your own ramp-up by learning our product and codebase with the goal of delivering something meaningful to creators by month's end. Understand how our recommendation and monetization products support creators, and how our systems—from Rails backend to React frontend, and our ClickHouse analytics layer—work together. Join team activities for planning, building, and measuring. Actively participate in code reviews, and contribute to PRs weekly.

  • First Six Months: Own and deliver multiple complex features from concept to launch. Improve our codebase through thoughtful refactoring while maintaining quality standards. Ensure service reliability by participating in on-call rotations. Present at least one Lunch & Learn session. Proactively identify and act on opportunities to improve our product and development processes.

Skills

  • Strong experience developing rich, performant web applications using React, JavaScript, and modern CSS frameworks like Tailwind

  • Ability to help scope ambitious designs into iterative releases. Contributing to MVP identification, sequencing deliverables, and shipping value incrementally rather than waiting for "done”

  • Ability to plan, estimate, and execute complex ambiguous projects independently while keeping stakeholders informed

Experiences

  • Breaking down complex, polished designs into shipping increments. Pushing back and shaping scope constructively and partnering with Product and Design to define iterative release plans

You understand the impact that you'll create to the bottom line, playing one of the most vital roles in the company. The day-to-day role includes collaboration with the wider sales team, market research to identify new potential customers and leads, and qualification of these leads by learning about their approach to onboarding.

Duties

• Drive Deel's growth through outbound prospecting efforts, generating sales leads based in the LATAM market that will turn into opportunities and closed business.

• Learn from our well-seasoned sales team and help build out our world-class Sales Playbook and Tech Stack.

• Educate and develop leads through inbound or outbound prospecting via phone calls, emails, events, webinars, and assorted campaigns.

• Identify and develop an in-depth understanding of each lead generation process, supporting marketing activities, prospect touch-points, and the handoff to an Account Executive.

• Generate emails sequences, make cold-calls to map and penetrate accounts.

• Conduct follow-up calls and emails until meetings are set.

• Keep meticulous records of interactions with leads in our CRM

• Attend local events in your city to generate sales opportunities and represent Deel

Requirements

• Based in LATAM

• Fluent in English & Spanish (Note: part of the interview process will be conducted in English)

• At least 3 months outbound SDR experience or similar

• Cold calling experience (minimum of 20 calls per day or 100 per week)

• You have an entrepreneurial spirit/experience with a strong growth mindset

• You have a way with words and can write email copy and sequence campaigns that convert

• You are adaptable and comfortable with a fast-paced, dynamic and customer facing environment

• You are an active relationship builder who can collaborate with internal and external teams to consistently improve processes and communication workflows

About the Role: We are seeking a passionate and highly experienced Staff Product Designer to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in shaping the future of our products, driving design excellence, and delivering delightful customer experiences. You will lead design initiatives across vertical and horizontal projects, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to ensure a cohesive and impactful user experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead Design Initiatives: Define and deliver product design across multiple initiatives, ensuring alignment with user needs and business goals. Lead the development of end-to-end features and services that resonate with our users.

  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and business partners, to build coherent, high-quality experiences that are both functional and delightful.

  • Advocate for Design Systems: Champion the Deel UI/Design System strategy, driving adoption through an iterative approach that balances consistency with innovation.

  • Design and Prototype at Speed: Rapidly design, prototype, and test new features based on a deep understanding of business, customers and technology, to deliver thoughtful solutions even in the face of ambiguity.

  • Mentor and Guide: Provide mentorship to Product Designers, offering constructive feedback to foster growth and skill development. Lead design practice rituals and develop new standards that enhance team efficiency.

  • Identify and Solve Bottlenecks: Partner with product and engineering teams to identify bottlenecks, make informed recommendations, and implement improvements that streamline process.

  • Drive Clarity from Complexity: Navigate ambiguity with ease, driving clarity and actionable insights from complex situations. Equally, balance user and business needs to create solutions that are impactful and strategic.

  • Outstanding Communication and Facilitation: Bring people together through inspiring design and narrative. Foster alignment across teams by effectively communicating a design vision and facilitating collaboration.

Requirements:

  • Passion for Design: A deep passion for Product Design and UX Design craft; committed to creating meaningful, impactful user experiences.

  • Extensive Experience: A minimum of 5-7 years as a Product Designer in a fast-paced environment, with at least 2 years leading holistic design as a Staff Product Designer (or equivalent title).

  • Multi-Disciplinary Expertise: Strong skills in UI, UX, and visual design, with a proven track record of crafting functional yet delightful customer experiences. Comfortable working through complex flows, creating engaging interfaces, and storytelling through visuals and prototypes.

  • AI: Curiosity about AI and emerging technologies; experience designing AI-assisted or AI-powered product experiences or using AI tools as part of your design workflow. A portfolio that includes examples of work related to AI-powered features, AI-assisted workflows, or experiments with AI tools.

  • Data-Informed Design: Your design work is deeply rooted in ideation, experimentation and evidence, ensuring that recommendations are always backed by data.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: Able to work at speed while maintaining high-quality and thoughtful solutions; driving clarity from complexity and ambiguity.

  • Balances User and Business Needs: Equally focused on user experience and business objectives, ensuring that design solutions meet both criteria effectively.

  • Strong Communicator and Facilitator: An outstanding communicator who can bring people together, build strong relationships, and gain alignment across teams. Inspires through design and narrative.

  • Mentorship Experience: Experienced in mentoring Product Designers, providing guidance that enables them to learn, grow, and progress in their careers.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Builds strong relationships with cross-functional partners, developing best practices for engagement and collaboration across the organisation.

  • Industry Knowledge: Strong knowledge of Payroll and Fintech, with the ability to apply this expertise to deliver impactful design solutions.

  • Embedded Team Experience: Experienced in being deeply embedded within a development team, working with a light touch from the Product Manager to deliver high-quality outcomes.

Design & AI at Deel
AI is changing how products are designed and built. At Deel, we’re excited about designers who are exploring how AI can enhance both the design process and the product experience.
We’re looking for designers who are curious about emerging technologies and who actively experiment with AI in their work. This could include improving design workflows, prototyping faster, exploring new interaction patterns, or helping shape AI-powered product experiences.
If you’ve worked on AI-related features or used AI tools as part of your design process, we’d love to see examples of that work in your portfolio.

Summary


The Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Deel is more than a single role—it’s the engine behind our global growth. We are constantly looking for ambitious builders to join our specialized SDR tracks, including Deel IT, Mobility (Immigration), Core (HR/Payroll), and GWC (Customer Expansion).

By applying here, you are entering our general SDR talent pool, where we match candidates to the team that best fits their strengths and interests. If you have a specific interest in one of our segments, please let us know in your application—we’re happy to tailor your interview path to the team that fits you best.

As our Sales Development Representative (SDR), you’ll play a vital role in our team by opening doors to new and existing opportunities and building strong relationships across all levels of our target customer segments. You’ll contribute directly to our growth, creating a significant impact in the company’s journey.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with our sales team, conduct market research to identify potential customers, help expand current business, and qualify leads through insightful conversations about global HR and workforce solutions.

Please note: This role requires that you reside within the United States or Canada.
Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Growth: Fuel our company’s growth by generating high-quality outbound leads (both new business and existing business) that can convert into meaningful sales opportunities and business wins.

  • Collaborate & Learn: Work alongside a seasoned sales team to build out our world-class Sales Playbook and Tech Stack, while sharing your insights to make these resources even better.

  • Engage & Educate: Engage leads through various channels—phone, email, events, webinars, and campaigns—to educate them and build interest in our solutions.

  • Master the Process: Develop a deep understanding of each stage in the lead generation process, from marketing initiatives and touchpoints to the transition of leads to an Account Executive.

  • Build & Refine Outreach: Create targeted email sequences and confidently reach out via cold calls to identify key contacts, establish relationships, and deepen connections.

  • Follow Through: Conduct timely follow-ups to nurture relationships and set up valuable meetings with our Account Executives.

What We’re Looking For

  • Growth-Oriented: You have a proactive approach and thrive in a fast-paced environment with a strong growth mindset.

  • Strong Communicator: You’re skilled at crafting messages that resonate and have experience writing emails and campaign copy that converts.

  • Team Player: You’re a natural relationship-builder who collaborates well with both internal and external teams, bringing fresh ideas to improve processes and communication.

  • Adaptable & Curious: You enjoy learning, embrace change, and are eager to evolve in a dynamic work environment.

Bonus Points (Not Required)

  • Experience in HR, Fintech, IT or related fields

  • Background in a fast-growing startup

  • Previous experience in a remote or distributed team

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are looking for passionate individuals ready to make an impact.

Summary
Responsible for overseeing the successful implementation, including data migration and configuration, of Deel's full HR suite for clients across the APAC region. Responsibilities

  • Lead complex HR implementation projects: Independently manage and execute complex implementation requests across Deel's full HR suite — including HRIS, Engage, ATS, Workforce Planning, and Compensation — ensuring a smooth and successful rollout for new and transitioning clients.

  • Platform expertise: Lead clients through the functional configuration of Deel HR suite products, translating their business requirements into platform setup and ensuring each module is configured to reflect their processes accurately.

  • Functional consulting: Serve as a trusted consultant to client stakeholders, proactively recommending best practices, suggesting practical workarounds, and helping clients get the most out of the platform — even when their requirements fall outside standard configurations.

  • Mentor and collaborate: Act as a mentor to new Implementation Managers, guiding them through complex scenarios and promoting best practices across the full HR suite.

  • Data migration and integrity: Oversee and perform data imports to migrate client data from outgoing HR systems into Deel, ensuring accuracy, data integrity, and compliance with data protection regulations.

  • Self-sufficient execution: Comfortable operating with a high degree of independence. Qualifications

  • Must have experience working with or managing clients across the broader APAC region.

  • Experience implementing or configuring across multiple HR product areas — such as HRIS/Core, ATS, Performance, Career and Learning, Workforce planning, or Compensation management.

  • Proven project management skills, with the ability to independently design, manage, and deliver implementation plans and schedules for clients.

  • Strong functional consulting ability — comfortable running discovery sessions, recommending best practices, and proposing workarounds when standard configurations don't fit client needs.

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a remote environment.

  • Passion for teaching and empowering both customers and colleagues, with a genuine commitment to customer service and relationship building.

  • Excellent communication skills, capable of clearly conveying complex ideas and data in written, presentation, and verbal formats.

  • Experience in payroll, preferred.

Porté par notre dynamique, soutenue par une valorisation de 17,3 milliards de dollars et un revenu annuel récurrent (ARR) d'un milliard de dollars en un peu plus de cinq ans, vous générerez un impact significatif tout en développant une expertise qui fera de vous un leader convoité de la transformation du travail à l'échelle mondiale.

Account Executive, PME

Le Rôle

Deel recrute pour plusieurs équipes au sein de son segment des petites et moyennes entreprises (PME). Nous recherchons des « hunters » infatigables qui excellent dans la découverte de nouvelles opportunités et qui savent générer une valeur immense pour nos clients.

En tant que gestionnaire de comptes (Account Executive), vous serez au cœur de notre croissance aux États-Unis et au Canada. Que vous fassiez découvrir Deel à une petite entreprise (1 à 20 employés) pour la première fois ou que vous élargissiez stratégiquement notre présence au sein d'un partenariat existant, vous gérerez l'intégralité du cycle de vente. Nous recherchons des professionnels proactifs et énergiques, capables de combiner la détermination d'un SDR à la finesse d'un AE chevronné pour simplifier l'embauche et la paie à l'international pour nos clients.

Vos responsabilités

  • Piloter le cycle de vente complet : Gérer l'ensemble du processus, de la prospection sortante et la qualification des prospects jusqu'à la négociation et la conclusion des ventes, tout en maintenant un entonnoir de vente sain et précis.

  • Découvrir et développer : Identifier et générer des revenus tant par l'acquisition de nouveaux clients que par la vente incitative (upselling) ou croisée (cross-selling) de la suite de solutions RH et de paie de Deel auprès de la clientèle actuelle.

  • Bâtir des partenariats stratégiques : Agir à titre de consultant auprès des fondateurs et des dirigeants en comprenant leurs processus internes pour recommander des solutions sur mesure qui favorisent le changement et maximisent la valeur à long terme.

  • Gérer votre carnet de clients : Gérer de manière proactive un portefeuille de comptes, diriger les revues d'affaires et exécuter des plans visant à accroître les taux de renouvellement et le potentiel de revenus.

  • Collaborer de manière interfonctionnelle : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement des ventes (SDR), le marketing et le succès client pour assurer une expérience fluide, de la première conversation au partenariat à long terme.

  • Représenter Deel : Agir en tant qu'ambassadeur de la marque lors d'événements de l'industrie (virtuels ou en personne) et maintenir des données rigoureuses dans le CRM pour faciliter les prévisions et les rapports.

Votre profil

  • Mentalité de « Chasseur » : Expérience éprouvée dans des rôles de SDR/BDR et d'AE, avec un historique de génération de votre propre entonnoir de vente par le biais d'appels à froid, de courriels et de prospection sur LinkedIn.

  • Excellence en vente : Plus de 2 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de conclusion de ventes (closing), de préférence dans le secteur SaaS ou technologique, idéalement avec un succès marqué dans des cycles transactionnels rapides de 30 jours ou moins.

  • Maîtrise des produits : Succès dans la vente multiproduits ou de solutions complexes; une expérience avec des produits de paie ou de RH est un atout majeur.

  • Détermination et adaptabilité : Vous vous épanouissez dans des environnements de télétravail de haute performance et possédez un esprit entrepreneurial vous permettant d'obtenir des résultats avec un minimum de supervision.

  • Présence exécutive : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et capacité à vulgariser des enjeux complexes de conformité mondiale en termes simples et exploitables pour des décideurs de niveau vice-présidence.

  • Rigueur analytique : Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres, hautement organisé et obsédé par l'idée d'offrir un service de classe mondiale tout en gérant plusieurs transactions et suivis simultanément.

Nous garantissons qu'une supervision humaine est maintenue pour toutes les décisions finales d'embauche. Vos données personnelles ne sont pas utilisées pour entraîner des modèles d'IA. Summary
You will support the day-to-day management of our portfolio tracking and help coordinate the quarterly collection of performance data from portfolio companies.   • Produce executive reports of overall portfolio performance

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field

  • Previous experience in Venture Capital or Investing is highly recommended

  • High proficiency in Excel and Google Suite

  • Excellent written and verbal English skills

As our SDR Enterprise | You'll be playing a crucial role in breaking into new accounts and fostering relationships with multiple contacts within all levels of our target customer segments. You understand the impact you'll create on the bottom line, playing one of the most vital roles in the company. The day-to-day role includes collaboration with the broader sales team, market research to identify new potential customers and leads, and qualification of these leads by learning about their approach to onboarding.


Responsibilities

  • Drive Deel's growth through inbound and outbound prospecting efforts, generating sales leads that will turn into opportunities and closed business.

  • Learn from our well-seasoned sales team and help build out our world-class Sales Playbook and Tech Stack.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and remote team environment

  • Self-motivated, results-driven, and eager to learn

  • Ability to work autonomously and self source solutions

  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a quota-carrying role

  • Experience with CRM systems and sales engagement tools is a plus

  • You are smart and work hard

  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit/experience with a strong growth mindset

  • You have a way with words and can write email copy and sequence campaigns that convert

  • You are adaptable and comfortable with a fast-paced environment

  • You are an active relationship builder who can collaborate with internal and external teams to consistently improve processes and communication workflows

  • You have worked for an HR or Fintech company, preferred

  • You've worked at a fast-growing startup, preferred

  • You have previously successfully worked in a remote & distributed team, preferred

As the Growth Marketing Science Lead, you will be the architect of our "Test and Learn" ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with the B2B sales funnel

  • Monitor post-acquisition integration progress and identify operational or financial risks

  • Identify process improvements and operational synergies following acquisitions

  • Maintain documentation and analysis supporting strategic transaction decisions

  • Strong financial modeling and valuation experience

  • Experience building DCF models, multiples analysis, precedent transaction analysis, and football field valuations

Equity is a critical component of how companies attract, retain, and reward talent globally, yet it remains highly complex, fragmented, and manual — especially when you go global.

At Deel, we are building a global equity platform that connects equity data, payroll, and compliance into a seamless experience. Today, we’ve only scratched the surface, with significant opportunities to automate manual workflows, expand into new worker types, and deeply integrate equity into broader products like compensation and total rewards.

You’ll join at a pivotal moment: owning execution for a high-growth product with low market penetration, strong demand, and a clear path to scale.

  • Own the day-to-day execution of the Equity product, working across both equity data and equity services

  • Drive delivery of a roadmap focused on AI, automation, scalability, and global compliance

  • Partner closely with engineering (distributed across EMEA and APAC) to ship high-impact features quickly

  • Work cross-functionally with compliance, payroll, and compensation product teams to ensure seamless integration

  • Define how Deel ingests and models equity data from external systems (e.g., stock administration platforms like Carta, Shareworks, Fidelity, and more)

  • Build and improve workflows around key equity events (e.g. vesting, reporting, compliance handling)

  • Identify and prioritise opportunities to reduce manual processes and operational overhead

  • Support expansion of the equity product into new geographies and additional worker types

  • Contribute to connecting equity into Deel’s broader ecosystem (e.g. total compensation and rewards)

  • Communicate progress, priorities, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders across product and business teams

  • Operate in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where speed and execution are critical

  • Delivery of a clear and well-executed roadmap focused on AI, automation, and product expansion

  • Reduction in manual operational processes through scalable product improvements

  • Increased adoption of the equity product across new worker types and geographies

  • Strong collaboration with compliance, payroll, and compensation product teams

  • Measurable growth in product usage and contribution to revenue within the Equity service

  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering and non-technical stakeholders

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics

  • Experience working in distributed, global teams

  • Accurate and accountable: You can accurately forecast your sales results, you see the gaps in your pipeline and you are ahead of the curve, you strive to always go above and beyond.

  • Teamwork: You have experience collaborating with teams across a growing company and building strong relationships.

Grâce à des outils propulsés par l'IA et une infrastructure de paie interne, Deel accompagne tous les types de travailleurs dans plus de 150 pays, aidant ainsi les entreprises à se développer de manière plus intelligente, plus rapide et plus conforme.

Comptant parmi les plus grandes entreprises au monde, notre équipe de 7 000 collaborateurs s'étend sur plus de 100 pays, parle 74 langues et porte une culture connectée et dynamique qui favorise l'apprentissage continu et l'innovation pour nos clients.

En tant qu'entreprise de Logiciel en tant que Service (SaaS) à la croissance la plus rapide de l'histoire, Deel transforme la manière dont les talents mondiaux se connectent aux entreprises de premier plan ; brisant les frontières qui limitent traditionnellement l'embauche et les opportunités de carrière. Nous ne nous contentons pas de créer un logiciel ; nous bâtissons l'infrastructure du futur du travail, favorisant une économie mondiale plus diverse et inclusive. En 2024 seulement, nous avons versé 11,2 milliards de dollars à des travailleurs dans près de 100 devises et fournit une couverture santé et des avantages sociaux dans 109 pays, garantissant que chacun soit rémunéré et protégé, peu importe où il se trouve.

À l'avant-garde de la révolution mondiale du travail, vous relèverez des défis complexes qui impactent la vie professionnelle de millions de personnes. Porté par notre dynamique, soutenue par une valorisation de 17,3 milliards de dollars et un revenu annuel récurrent (ARR) d'un milliard de dollars en un peu plus de cinq ans, vous générerez un impact significatif tout en développant une expertise qui fera de vous un leader convoité de la transformation du travail à l'échelle mondiale.

Grâce à une plateforme intuitive, les clients peuvent se procurer, déployer, réparer et récupérer des parcs entiers d'appareils et d'équipements de bureau à domicile pour leurs employés dans plus de 120 pays.

  • Prise en charge et exécution : Vous prenez en charge l'ensemble du cycle de vente du début à la fin, en naviguant dans des ententes commerciales complexes grâce à des relations solides et à des négociations menées jusqu'à la conclusion.

  • Excellent(e) communicateur(trice) : Vous communiquez avec aisance et possédez de solides compétences en présentation. Vous savez articuler et mettre en valeur la proposition de valeur de Deel IT pour gagner la confiance des clients et conclure des ententes.

  • Esprit de propriétaire : Vous êtes passionné(e) par le produit et la mission de Deel IT, et vous le démontrez positivement à chaque interaction, que ce soit dans le cadre du cycle de vente ou au-delà.

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We’re looking for a strategic and technically savvy Solutions Engineer to partner closely with the Deel IT Sales Team. In this role, you'll work hand-in-hand with Account Executives and Product teams to support prospective clients as they explore Deel’s fast-growing IT product suite - ranging from global hardware procurement to Device Lifecycle Management Logistics.

You’ll be instrumental in translating complex client needs into actionable, scalable, and compliant solutions - supporting every stage of the sales process from discovery through to implementation hand-off.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives in pre-sales cycles to uncover technical and operational pain points related to global IT equipment deployment, asset lifecycle management, and cross-border workforce support.

  • Design and present tailored IT solution packages that may include device procurement/leasing models, HRIS integrations, global device lifecycle solutions, and SLA-backed managed services.

  • Act as the technical voice in client meetings - owning demos, RFP responses, IT security reviews, and product deep-dives.

  • Translate customer workflows and requirements into proposed configurations and processes within Deel’s IT platform.

  • Stay ahead of evolving trends in global workforce IT support.

  • 3+ years of experience in a client-facing Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Technical Consulting, or similar role - preferably in SaaS, IT Asset Management, or HR Tech.

  • Strong understanding of IT procurement, device lifecycle management, or SaaS integrations (ITSM systems, MDM, SSO, Endpoint Security etc).

  • Comfort discussing APIs, data flows, and systems architecture with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills - able to simplify complex solutions and clearly articulate ROI.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration instincts and the ability to manage competing priorities in fast-moving sales cycles.

  • Deep analytical mindset with the ability to build excel based tools to drive client solutions.

  • Bonus: Experience supporting enterprise clients in multi-country environments.

Ce que nous faisons définit qui nous sommes.

Deel est la plateforme tout-en-un de paie et de RH dédiée aux équipes internationales. Notre vision est de donner à chaque individu, équipe et entreprise accès aux opportunités mondiales. Conçue pour répondre aux modes de travail actuels, Deel regroupe le SIRH, la paie, la conformité légale, les avantages sociaux, la performance et la gestion des équipements au sein d'une interface unique et fluide. En tant qu'entreprise de Logiciel en tant que Service (SaaS) à la croissance la plus rapide de l'histoire, Deel transforme la manière dont les talents mondiaux se connectent aux entreprises de premier plan ; brisant les frontières qui limitent traditionnellement l'embauche et les opportunités de carrière.   • 3 ans ou plus d'expérience dans un rôle axé sur la clientèle en ingénierie de solutions, prévente, consultation technique ou un rôle similaire — de préférence dans le domaine du SaaS, de la gestion des actifs TI ou des RH Tech.

  • Aisance à discuter d'API, de flux de données et d'architecture de systèmes avec des interlocuteurs tant techniques que non techniques.

  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en narration — capacité à simplifier des solutions complexes et à articuler clairement le retour sur investissement.

  • Solides instincts de collaboration interfonctionnelle et capacité à gérer des priorités concurrentes dans des cycles de vente en évolution rapide.

  • Esprit analytique développé avec la capacité de créer des outils basés sur Excel pour orienter les solutions clients.

In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of Deel's field marketing programs (mainly events and webinars) treating each activation as an integrated campaign with clear pipeline objectives, from initial awareness to post-event nurture and revenue impact.

Reporting to the EMEA Marketing Lead, you will work in close partnership with Sales, SDR, and global Marketing teams to build locally relevant programs that drive measurable engagement and pipeline growth. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in events and webinar execution, combined with a strong campaign mindset and the analytical rigor to continuously optimise performance.

Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy and end-to-end execution of Deel's DACH & Benelux field marketing portfolio, including regional trade shows, industry conferences, executive dinners, sales acceleration events, and webinars.

  • Develop localised messaging and assets in collaboration with regional lead, product marketing, content, and creative teams, ensuring regional relevance and brand consistency

  • Partner with SDR and Sales leadership to maximise lead conversion and ensure tight alignment between event activity and pipeline outcomes

  • Manage all operational aspects of the program: vendor relationships, budget tracking, logistics, and onsite delivery

  • Align with the Partner Events Manager on co-marketing activations and partner-sponsored events

  • Define and own KPIs for all regional programs, with a focus on pipeline contribution, engagement quality, and ROI

  • Use performance data and sales feedback to continuously refine the regional event and webinar strategy, format selection, and campaign approach

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in field marketing, with deep expertise in event and webinar management within a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment

  • Demonstrated ability to run events and webinars as integrated marketing campaigns — not just logistics, but full-funnel programs with measurable impact

  • Strong understanding of demand generation principles and how field marketing activity connects to pipeline and revenue

  • Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics, building reports, and translating data into strategic recommendations

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders across Sales, SDR, Partnerships, and global Marketing teams

  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

  • Proficiency in Salesforce, HubSpot, Looker, and Swoogo preferred

  • Fluent in Dutch + professional level of English

engineering fundamentals, this role is essential for building scalable, production-grade features

  • Identify and Solve Bottlenecks: Partner with product and engineering to identify friction points and implement improvements that streamline the user journey and team process.

  • Drive Clarity from Complexity: Navigate ambiguity with ease, balancing user and business needs to create solutions that are impactful and strategic.

  • Outstanding Communication and Facilitation: Bring people together through inspiring design and narrative, fostering alignment across teams.

  • Passion for Design: A deep passion for Product Design, UX craft, and growth — committed to creating impactful user experiences that drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Extensive Experience: 5–7 years as a Product Designer, with at least 2 years as a Staff Product Designer (or equivalent), and proven growth design experience.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Builds strong relationships with cross-functional partners across the organisation.

About the role

We're looking for an Infrastructure Tech Lead to join our Infra Core team at Deel. This is a staff-level, technical leadership role (with no direct people management). You will be the most senior technical voice on a team of four to five engineers, setting the technical direction while doing real, hands-on work in equal measure.

In this role, technical depth is not optional. You will stay close to the architecture, code, and infrastructure while simultaneously shaping the roadmap and raising the team's bar. Your primary focus is the application layer: how services are built, observed, and scaled across the organization. You will be building the control plane, tooling, and infrastructure primitives that hundreds of Deel engineers depend on every day.

How we build at Deel

As a hyper-growth company, new initiatives and shifting priorities are the norm here. This is not an environment for "maintenance-mode" engineering. We are builders. Our philosophy is simple: identify the biggest bottleneck, build a robust solution, ship it, and immediately move on to tackle the next massive problem. If you thrive in a high-velocity environment where your work has an immediate, wide-scale impact, you'll feel right at home.

The challenges ahead

  • Engineering-Led Product Ownership: We do not have a Product Manager. The shaping of what the team works on, prioritizing the roadmap, and determining how to tangibly improve developers' lives at Deel is 100% driven by you and the team.

  • Architectural Impact: You will design patterns and infrastructure for a rapidly growing Kubernetes ecosystem, shaping how hundreds of microservices are built, deployed, and efficiently scaled globally.

  • Expert Troubleshooting & Noise Reduction: You are the ultimate escalation point during critical production incidents. We handle thousands of internal support and infrastructure requests every quarter—you won't just help answer them; you will treat that toil as an engineering problem and build the automation required to eliminate it.

  • Service Provisioning & Developer Experience: Transform how a new service goes from approved to running. You'll automate secure provisioning, database setups, and environment registrations so teams can deploy to Dev, Demo, Prod on the exact same day without Infra becoming a bottleneck.

  • Edge Routing & Traffic Management: Drive massive architectural shifts at the routing layer. You will tackle projects equivalent in scale and complexity to replacing entire ingress controller fleets or migrating massive backend traffic volumes to centralized API gateways without dropping requests.

  • Secrets Management & Infrastructure Security: Lead enterprise-scale secrets management and security posture improvements. You will architect zero-downtime secret rotation, eliminate legacy credential injection methods, and enforce strict boundaries between sensitive data and GitOps-driven configurations.

  • Application Observability at Scale: Spearhead the evolution of our observability stack. You will deprecate legacy tracing systems, drive the adoption of unified OpenTelemetry standards across hundreds of microservices, and build high-volume logging pipelines that give teams the exact signals they need.

  • Real-time & Agentic Infrastructure: Architect and deploy new platform capabilities, from enterprise-scale real-time WebSocket infrastructure to ensuring our platform natively and efficiently supports the massive influx of event-driven and AI-agentic workloads.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with DevOps, DBA, InfoSec, and product engineering teams to align on organizational goals. You will represent the infrastructure domain in architectural conversations, resolving complex multi-team technical challenges and driving shared objectives.

These are only a glimpse of all the challenges ahead.

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years specifically focused on infrastructure (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps, CNCF landscape).

  • Programming Expertise: Expertise in writing production-grade code in Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, or Python.

  • Technical Leadership: 2+ years of experience acting as a technical lead, mentoring engineers, and successfully driving projects with distributed, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones (this is a player-coach role, no direct HR management).

  • Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Architectures: Proven experience designing high-performance, highly available distributed systems. You should have deep familiarity with message brokers (NATS, Kafka) and building event-driven architectures on top of them.

  • Kubernetes Mastery: Experience designing and operating systems that extend Kubernetes—whether by building operators and controllers, integrating and customizing third-party tools, or architecting custom platform primitives on top of Kubernetes APIs.

  • Database Familiarity: Solid operational experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), particularly around how they integrate and scale within a modern platform.

  • A track record of delivery: You have taken complex infrastructure projects from inception to delivery—writing the roadmap, aligning stakeholders, hitting milestones, and successfully shipping.

  • Excellent Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can articulate complex architectural tradeoffs clearly to both product engineers and leadership.

  • A bias for action: You make the tough calls, document your decisions, and never let perfect become the enemy of good.

Nice to have

  • Experience with internal developer platforms (IDP), developer experience tooling, or self-serve platform engineering. (While this role is primarily infrastructure-focused, platform instincts are a strong bonus.)

Technical depth alone isn't enough for this role. The person who will thrive here can hold a strong technical vision, align a team behind it, and execute; even through ambiguity or disagreement. Role Overview

As the DevSecOps Team Lead, you will be the bridge between Security, Operations, and Engineering. Your mission is to empower development teams to ship software faster and more securely by providing them with automated guardrails, self-service security tools, and expert architectural guidance.

 

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Team Management

  • Team Growth: Lead, mentor, and coach a team of DevSecOps engineers. Conduct performance reviews, manage career development paths, and foster a culture of high performance.

  • Roadmap Ownership: Define the DevSecOps strategy and multi-quarter roadmap, aligning security initiatives with broader business and engineering goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary point of contact for Engineering and Product leads to ensure security requirements are baked into the Product Discovery phase.

Security Architecture & Governance

  • Policy-as-Code: Lead the implementation of organizational guardrails using tools like OPA (Open Policy Agent) or Kyverno to ensure compliance is automated across all environments.

Experience

We are looking for an experienced clinician who is well versed in all aspects of ophthalmology.  This person will be responsible for building relationships with a clinical site’s research coordinators and PI’s, performing a medical record review of pre-identified patients to evaluate clinical trial eligibility based on a sponsor’s protocol, delivering the results to the sites, and monitoring and collecting the outcomes. You will also be responsible for managing the sponsor relationship as it pertains to the individual project, updating them and meeting with them as contractually agreed, and knowing when to include a commercial team member or point of escalation if needed.  

This role will work closely with our data science and research team to ensure quality and accuracy of client deliverables as well as serving as an SME for consulting on eligibility criteria when needed.

Additional tasks may be assigned based on necessity, so the ability to remain flexible and be willing to assume additional responsibilities as our company grows is a must.

  • Manage site relationships for awarded projects
  • Review EHR records as it pertains to sponsor protocols and eligibility criteria.
  • manage deliverable to sites, tailoring as needed and as contractually agreed to ensure positive relationships and outcomes for both sites and sponsors.
  • Serve as an ophthalmology SME for collaboration and adjudication on ophthalmic or medical criteria with our research and data science team, for both awarded and no awarded work.
  • Attend key conferences to help build and maintain relationships with sites and coordinators, facilitating confidence in our services to them.
  • Serve as a US POC for our US sites as related to Candidate Identification projects.

  • Associates Degree, Completion of a Certified Ophthalmic Technician Program, COT, COA, or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset
  • Experience as a CRC is nice to have, but not required.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Knowledgeable in industry best practices as related to GCP, GDPR, and other relevant policies.
  • Willing and able to travel up to 25% of the time.

US Compliance & Reimbursement

By aligning our processes with the latest legal requirements, we foster a secure and trustworthy environment for our users. Our efforts are pivotal in paving the way for a bright and sustainable future in the crypto industry.
 
About the role
We are looking for a passionate Full Stack Developer who takes pride in delivering polished, high-quality products end-to-end — from intuitive React/Vue frontends to robust Java microservices backends. You will join a team building agentic flows and compliance systems from scratch, where AI-augmented development is embedded in how we work. If you are a proactive self-starter with strong ownership, genuine curiosity for AI and crypto, and the drive to build meaningful systems at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

About the Role
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Risk Analyst ( KYC Fraud Prevention & Compliance Rule Analysis) to join our Risk Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for using rules/ML models/AI to a) detect and prevent fraudulent activities related to onboarding processes and existing user accounts; and b) leverage risk team data insights to support co-prevention scope for compliance TS/TM direction. You will play a key role in protecting our platform’s integrity, ensuring compliance with KYC (Know Your Customer) regulations, and safeguarding our users’ assets.
 
Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
